instruction: A tranquil Japanese tea room: tatami mat flooring, a low wooden table with a full tea set mid-ceremony, a tokonoma alcove with a hanging scroll and ikebana arrangement, translucent shoji screens glowing with afternoon light, a small bonsai, and a glimpse of a rock garden through a partially open screen. Steam rises softly from the iron kettle.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Japanese Tea House Room. A tranquil Japanese tea room: tatami mat flooring, a low wooden table with a full tea set mid-ceremony, a tokonoma alcove with a hanging scroll and ikebana arrangement, translucent shoji screens glowing with afternoon light, a small bonsai, and a glimpse of a rock garden through a partially open screen. Steam rises softly from the iron kettle. Style: serene minimalist. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
